# observability-mcp

> FastMCP 3.3+ control plane for unified fleet monitoring (Grafana 12000, Prometheus 12001, Loki 12002).

## What it is

- MCP HTTP: 12007 (`/mcp`)
- Web chart picker: 12008 (`/grafana`)
- Process metrics: 12009 (`/metrics`)
- Does NOT run a second PLG stack — use mcp-central-docs/monitoring

## Key tools

check_stack_status, manage_grafana_dashboards, manage_grafana_datasources, query_loki_logs, monitor_server_health, show_status_dashboard, provision_standard_dashboards

## Docs

- docs/PRD.md
- docs/FASTMCP_STATUS.md
- CHANGELOG.md
- .env.unified-monitoring.example

## Start

web_sota/start.ps1 — requires unified monitoring at 12000-12002
